items.title: What are the main events for today?
items.summary: EUROPEAN SESSION In the European session, we get the Swiss Q3 GDP and the Eurozone Industrial Production. None of the data will change anything for the respective central banks, so the market reaction will likely be muted.  The market's focus remains on the Fed and the US-Iran stalemate.
